xml:
A palimpsest is a manuscript page whose original writing has been scraped or washed away so it can be written on again, often leaving traces of the earlier text. Figuratively, a palimpsest is something whose earlier forms or history remain visible beneath its present appearance.

A manuscript surface reused after earlier writing was erased; figuratively, something retaining traces of earlier layers or forms.
